newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle slow, thin $113/dressed- trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle slow, thin $113/dressed- trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Friday were extremely slow and not fully established, according to market sources.

About 100 head of lighter weight heifers reportedly were sold at $113.00 per cwt on a dressed basis. The bulk of this week's sales for steers and heifers ranged from $113.00 to $114.00, depending on quality, the sources said.
Most of this week's showlist also was sold, with those cattle left over said to be unfinished.
This week's sales totaled 52,600 head as of Thursday, nearly matching the showlist estimate of 53,000.
